_comment: Demo trust model (DESIGN §6): a version-controlled allowlist of issuer
identifiers, loaded by the verifier service. A production trust registry is
Why this file has to exist: Sunbird RC v2.1.0's OID4VP verifier checks that a
presented credential's signature is VALID, but never checks WHO signed it (see
signature, nonce, audience, credential signatures, holder binding, revocation,
plus DCQL). Any issuer able to mint the same `vct` would otherwise be accepted.
The verifier service enforces this allowlist before any business rule runs.
${VARS} are expanded from the environment at load time, so the policy stays
stable in Git while the locally-minted did:web does not. An unset or unexpanded
variable is a hard failure, never a wildcard.
